newsitem.title: FINLAND: LAROX TO FACE FIM 20 MLN CHARGES BY OUTOKUMPU.
newsitem.headline: LAROX TO FACE FIM 20 MLN CHARGES BY OUTOKUMPU.

text.p: Finnish industrial filters and valve maker Larox Oy said in a statement on Tuesday it will face almost 20 million markka damage claims by metal and mining group Outokumpu Oy for an alleged violation against a patent.
"Larox has in earlier negotiations denied the alleged patent violation," Larox said.
"Outokumpu now demands almost 20 million markka, which is way out of proportion with what has been stated in discussions on the issue," Larox said.

Larox said its managing director Timo Vartianen will stick with the company's view that it has not violated the patent. The overdimensioned damage claim is unjustified and is harming the operations of Larox, the company said.
